description: 여수광양항만공사_외항 및 지역별 선박입출항 통계_GW [ports and harbours] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 여수광양항만공사. 이를 통해 항만을 이용하는 외항 선박의 지역별 분포와 물동량 편중 현황을 파악할 수 있습니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 여수광양항만공사. Its tags are 광양항선박통계, 외항입출항, 지역별 통계, 선박척수, 총톤수. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2026-06-05 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
